summary: Configured replicated CORP.EXAMPLE/CORP Samba AD on node1/node2, joined node3/node4, published the engineering share, and verified Kerberos, DNS, replication, permissions, and persistence settings. Credentials are stored on node4 without disclosure.
actions_performed: Configured identity-network-only Samba services and persistent dual-DC DNS resolution.
Created engineering and infrasetuser; added the user to the group.
Joined FILESERVER and CLIENT computer accounts.
Configured engineering-group write access and ordinary-user write denial.
Verified both DCs authenticate Kerberos requests and advertise replicated DNS records.
Verified share read/write, create/modify, and ordinary-user access controls.
Verified AD database replication checks: 3,856 objects, zero errors on both DCs.
Enabled required services for reboot persistence; no reboot or failure injection performed.
